title: STARTDT activation baseline
purpose: Exercise the minimal IEC 60870-5-104 U-format activation parser path with a compact valid frame before application ASDUs are exchanged.
expected_behavior: Peer recognizes a valid STARTDT activation U-frame and transitions link state without crash.
constraints_preserved: Length octet 0x04 matches a 4-byte APCI U-format frame

Relies on widely recognized 104 U-format control value for STARTDT activation as conservative model-prior completion
issue_safety_notes: Safe structural analogue only; minimal valid U-frame chosen to reach protocol state handling without reproducing the reported crashing input.
